company.name: Kiddom
company.shortDescription: Kiddom is an education platform offering a digital curriculum to engage students virtually or in the classroom.
company.description: Kiddom is an education platform offering a digital curriculum to engage students at home or in the classroom. It combines curriculum management, instruction, assessment, and communication tools into one solution to save schools valuable time, resources, and money. With the flexibility to access and edit curriculum from any location, it that can effectively support teachers and learners engaging in in-class, blended, hybrid, or distance learning scenarios, as well as in the quick pivots between them.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based K–12 platform connecting curriculum, lesson planning, instruction, assignments, assessment, grading, reporting, and student data in one system.
productsAndServices.name: Kiddom Digital Learning Environment

productsAndServices.description: A portfolio of standards-aligned K–12 digital curricula in mathematics, English language arts, science, social studies, and phonics, available with print and classroom kit materials.
productsAndServices.name: Kiddom Core Curriculum

productsAndServices.description: An instructional intelligence layer that uses curriculum, assessment, and classroom data to surface instructional challenges and guide teachers’ next instructional decisions.
productsAndServices.name: Atlas by Kiddom

productsAndServices.description: A teacher-facing set of AI tools for summarizing curriculum, generating practice and scaffolds, grading open-ended work, and providing feedback aligned to instructional materials.
productsAndServices.name: Kiddom AI

productsAndServices.description: Implementation, onboarding, professional learning, training, and ongoing support services for schools and districts adopting Kiddom curricula and technology.
productsAndServices.name: Kiddom Professional Learning and Customer Success

productsAndServices.description: A digital California mathematics curriculum based on Illustrative Mathematics for grades K–8, Algebra 1, Geometry, and Algebra 2.
productsAndServices.name: Kiddom IM® v.360 California

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $35,000,000, or 61.95% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $26,807,366 to $233,527,767, a 8.71x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 81 (-6 over 90 days) and market heat at 70 (-15).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include ClassDojo, PowerSchool, 4DX Ventures.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
